authority: public discovery and commercial-pilot handoff; customer monitoring is restricted to explicitly authorized surfaces and grants no production-mutation authority
boundaries: public discovery creates no access to private repositories, credentials, customer data or internal topology
customer monitoring begins only after explicit scoped authorization for the repositories, endpoints or systems being checked
findings are operational evidence and diagnostics, not a security certification, compliance attestation or uptime guarantee
production changes, payment actions and external communications remain separately gated
customer-specific monitoring execution is not represented as live until onboarding and its first receipt-backed cycle are verified

commercial.pricing: Custom quote based on portfolio size, repositories, public endpoints, workflow count and monitoring scope.
commercial.payment_state: No direct machine checkout is exposed. Commercial terms and any later payment require explicit human agreement and authoritative payment verification.
